chapters.status: implemented; permanent evidence, chapter quests and journal
chapters.question: What happened to our mother?
chapters.discovery: Mother opened the way home for people held inside unfinished tales, but the effort cost her life. The forest kept her last account as an unfinished role; it is an echo. Her message remembers the player and asks them to keep a place where people can arrive under their own names.
chapters.completion_contract: Read the final account, refuse to inherit her unfinished role, restore her own name and plant the seeds from her tin in the restored garden. Leave free play and ordinary expeditions available.
